ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 75-80% high-intensity white pixels in the central regions and 20-25% low-intensity black pixels along the margins and trailing edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe: large white contiguous region with one discrete dark circular spot in the lower-central area. Right lobe: large white contiguous region featuring a vertical linear cluster of three discrete dark circular spots in the mid-section and a larger dark blotch near the inferior inner margin.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serration across the entire superior boundary; characterized by jagged peaks and deep valleys isolated against the background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the lateral margins of both lobes, tapering inward toward the splash zone.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast, circular, light-toned calcified structures (barnacles) localized on the extreme superior-lateral tips of both the left and right fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular serration and potential tissue loss along the trailing edge; significant barnacle colonization on distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique vertical triplet of dark circular spots located in the central-right fluke lobe.
